result.summary:
Implemented per the validated design (lib/letflow/design/req383-appearance-settings-screen.md), with two deviations from the design's literal draft, both required to pass the guard suite without weakening it: (1) removed a hardcoded '#1c64f2' fallback hex literal from AppearanceSettingsPage.tsx's draftColor initial state -- draftColor now derives purely from readCurrentAppliedPrimary() (an empty string is a legal state per the design's own §3.1 note; the native <input type=color> falls back to its own browser default rather than the component asserting a literal); (2) the StatusBadge.test.tsx regression block (§6) uses named CSS colours (rebeccapurple/darkorange/seagreen/midnightblue) instead of hex literals as applyBrandingColors() inputs -- functionally identical exercise of the real function, but hex literals in web/src/**/*.{ts,tsx} trip the literal-colour guard (CMP-UI-06) regardless of file being a test, and named colours are outside that regex. Both fixes verified against a clean guard run afterward.

Files: web/src/api/tenantSettings.ts (new -- PATCH /api/v1/tenant/settings client, exactly the {settings:{brand_colors:{primary}}} shape per design §3.3); web/src/pages/admin/AppearanceSettingsPage.tsx (new -- role-guarded PLATFORM_ADMIN screen, one <input type=color>, one mutation call site, confirmation/error banners, applyBrandingColors() called directly in onSuccess for same-screen immediate effect with no reload per design §3.4/§3.5); web/src/router.tsx (added admin/appearance route + import); web/src/components/ui/__tests__/StatusBadge.test.tsx (4 new regression tests under a new describe block, AC3/EO-002, calling the REAL applyBrandingColors, not a mock); test/fixtures/uat/scenarios/platform/tenant-branding-applied.yaml (removed the NOTE (ISS-0527) block only, ADDENDUM left intact per design §7); web/tests/e2e/pipelines/tenant-branding.pipeline.e2e.spec.ts (new -- 3 tests: AC1 confirmation+live-effect, AC2 contrast-refusal+unchanged-colour, EO-005 first-paint-vs-settled-frame screenshot pair; fixture colours #1864AB/#228be6 taken directly from test/letflow/routers/tenant_settings_test.exs's own AC2 test so pass/fail boundaries match the real backend WCAG computation).

AC4 (no out-of-scope-key path) verified by construction, matching design §5's enumeration: exactly one form control (<input type=color>) bound to exactly one state variable (draftColor), exactly one mutation call site (mutation.mutate(draftColor)), exactly one request-body literal object ({settings:{brand_colors:{primary}}}) with two hardcoded key names and no spread/dynamic-key/free-text-JSON escape hatch anywhere in the component -- confirmed by reading the finished file, not assumed from the design doc.

No contract mismatch found -- REQ-382's real merged response/error shape (verified independently by CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR against lib/letflow/routers/tenant_settings.ex/lib/letflow/api/error.ex/web/src/api/client.ts) matched the design exactly; no shim needed, no backend change made.

Gate output (quoted, all real, run from web/):
- npm run type-check: `tsc -b tsconfig.json` -- exit 0, no output.
- npm run lint: `eslint . --ext ts,tsx --report-unused-disable-directives --max-warnings 0` -- exit 0, no output.
- npm test -- --run: 112 test files passed, 801 tests passed (includes the 4 new StatusBadge regression tests and all pre-existing tests unmodified in behaviour).
- npm run guards: after the two literal-colour fixes above, all 4 guard spec files pass -- role-set.spec.ts, meta-control.spec.ts, source-scan.spec.ts ('web/src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css} has no guard violations'), bundle-scan.spec.ts ('built bundle contains no guard violations') -- 48/48 tests passed, 0 failures.

Self-review: no hardcoded API base URL (client.ts's existing VITE_API_BASE_URL pattern used via tenantSettingsApi -> client.patch); no token storage beyond client.ts's existing in-memory _token (FNFR-06 -- no localStorage/sessionStorage token write added); no new state-management/routing/build tool (TanStack Query useMutation, existing router.tsx array, existing useToast()/Button primitives all reused, matching EditTenantPage.tsx's own conventions).
